name: Toe Walking

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program

steps: Stand upright in an open space with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up as high as possible onto the balls of your feet and toes, lifting your heels completely off the ground.
Take small, steady steps forward while maintaining maximum height on your toes.
Walk for the prescribed duration or distance, keeping your calves contracted continuously.
coaching_cues: Stay tall and maintain an engaged core for balance.
Do not allow your ankles to roll outward; keep weight evenly distributed across the balls of your feet and big toes.

sources.attribution: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program
